title: USDC faces bank-rate pressure – Can Visa’s payments push offset it?
summary: Stablecoins face a growth test as bank yields rise, while real-world payment activity creates new opportunities for adoption.
content: USDC faces mounting growth pressure as traditional bank yields rise, presenting a challenge for stablecoin adoption. However, new initiatives by Visa to integrate real-world payments could help offset these pressures by driving broader transaction activity and utility across financial networks.
content_ta: பாரம்பரிய வங்கி வட்டி விகிதங்கள் உயர்வதால் USDC வளர்ச்சிச் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறது, இது ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் பயன்பாட்டுக்கு ஒரு சோதனையாக அமைந்துள்ளது. எனினும், நிஜ உலகப் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை இணைக்க Visa மேற்கொள்ளும் புதிய முயற்சிகள் இந்த அழுத்தங்களைச் சமாளிக்க உதவும்.

title: Acorns buys Gen Z social finance app Frich
summary: Savings and investment app Acorns has acquired Gen Z-focused social finance app Frich. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
content: Savings and investment app Acorns has announced the acquisition of Frich, a social finance application specifically designed for Generation Z users. The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed by either company. This strategic move allows Acorns to expand its reach and appeal to younger demographics by integrating social financial features into its existing platform.
content_ta: சேமிப்பு மற்றும் முதலீட்டு செயலியான Acorns, Gen Z பயனர்களை இலக்காகக் கொண்ட சோஷியல் ஃபைனான்ஸ் செயலியான Frich-ஐ வாங்கியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தத்தின் நிதி விவரங்கள் வெளியிடப்படவில்லை. இந்த மூலோபாய நடவடிக்கை Acorns நிறுவனம் இளம் தலைமுறையினரை ஈர்க்கும் வகையில் தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்த உதவும்.

content: World, the digital identity project co-founded by Sam Altman, has introduced a new suite of tools to help the banking and finance sector combat AI-driven impersonation and deepfake fraud. The newly launched security features are designed to protect customer accounts, employee workflows, and digital agents from sophisticated digital identity threats.
content_ta: Sam Altman-ஆல் இணை-நிறுவப்பட்ட டிஜிட்டல் அடையாள திட்டமான World, வங்கி மற்றும் நிதித்துறையில் AI-மூலம் செய்யப்படும் ஆள்மாறாட்டம் மற்றும் டீப்ஃபேக் மோசாடுகளைத் தடுக்க புதிய கருவிகளை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. வாடிக்கையாளர் கணக்குகள் மற்றும் பணியாளர்களின் வேலைப்பாய்வுகளைப் பாதுகாக்க இந்த பாதுகாப்பு அம்சங்கள் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.

content: Meta has blamed an artificial intelligence tool for the mistaken suspension of the No Kings Coalition Instagram account. title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.
content: Qubic halted its blockchain after an attacker compromised over a thousand wallets using weak seeds. The network reported that a significant portion of the stolen funds remains on the blockchain, while some assets were successfully frozen at the MEXC cryptocurrency exchange. Network validators are currently preparing to vote on a comprehensive recovery plan to address the security breach.
content_ta: பலவீனமான சீட்களை பயன்படுத்தி ஆயிரத்திற்கும் மேற்பட்ட வாலட்டுகளில் இருந்து ஹேக்கர் திருடியதை தொடர்ந்து Qubic தனது பிளாக்செயினை தற்காலிகமாக முடக்கியது. திருடப்பட்ட நிதியில் பெரும்பகுதி பிளாக்செயினில் அப்படியே இருப்பதாகவும், சில சொத்துக்கள் MEXC கிரிப்டோ பரிமாற்றத்தில் முடக்கப்பட்டதாகவும் நெட்வொர்க் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த பாதுகாப்பு மீறல் தொடர்பான மீட்புத் திட்டம் குறித்து வாக்களிக்க நெட்வொர்க் வேலிடேட்டர்கள் தயாராகி வருகின்றனர்.

title: Algorand tops post-quantum race with 2.7M secure transfers- Will it rally ALGO?
summary: Algorand still does not have a full post-quantum security across its entire stack
content: Recent reports suggest Algorand is leading in the post-quantum race with millions of secure transfers, sparking questions about whether the ALGO token will rally. However, research clarifies that Algorand still does not feature full post-quantum security across its entire technology stack, highlighting ongoing challenges in achieving complete quantum resistance for the network.
content_ta: போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பந்தயத்தில் மில்லியன் கணக்கான பாதுகாப்பான பரிமாற்றங்களுடன் Algorand முன்னணியில் இருப்பதாக சமீபத்திய அறிக்கைகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன, இது ALGO டோக்கன் மீண்டு வருமா என்ற கேள்விகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், Algorand இன் முழு ஸ்டாக்கிலும் இன்னும் முழுமையான போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் பாதுகாப்பு இல்லை என்று ஆராய்ச்சி தெளிவுபடுத்துகிறது.

title: Black Monday Fears Fade as Nasdaq Futures Rally After Friday Selloff
summary:
Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 0.9% early Monday, defying Black Monday calls after Friday's chip-led Wall Street selloff.
The post Black Monday Fears Fade as Nasdaq Futures Rally After Friday Selloff appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Nasdaq 100 futures rebounded by approximately 0.9 percent during early Monday trading, helping to ease widespread fears of a severe market crash following Friday's significant chip-led selloff on Wall Street. Despite earlier concerns and warnings of a potential Black Monday event, major stock index futures showed positive momentum as the trading week began.
content_ta: வெள்ளிக்கிழமை Wall Street சந்தையில் ஏற்பட்ட சரிவுக்குப் பிறகு, திங்கட்கிழமை தொடக்க வர்த்தகத்தில் Nasdaq 100 ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் சுமார் 0.9 சதவீதம் உயர்ந்தது. இதனால் Black Monday குறித்த அச்சம் தணிந்துள்ளது. சந்தை சரிவு குறித்த எச்சரிக்கைகள் இருந்தபோதிலும், வர்த்தக வாரம் தொடங்கியபோது முக்கிய பங்கு குறியீட்டு ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் நேர்மறையான போக்கைக் காட்டியது.

title: Fed Hike Before December? Ben Emons Says Data, Not Midterms, Decides
summary:

summary: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
content: World Liberty Financial's USD1 stablecoin has experienced a significant drop in its market capitalization, shedding more than $400 million over a two-week period. This decline was driven by large redemptions occurring across both the Ethereum and BNB Chain networks, reflecting ongoing shifts and liquidity challenges for the digital asset.

title: Sam Altman's World Takes Proof-of-Human IDs to Banks, Citing $40B AI Fraud Risk
summary: Bain Capital, VanEck and Pantera Capital are among design partners for the offering, which also lets users delegate proofs to AI agents.
content: Sam Altman's World is expanding its proof-of-human identity system to banks, citing a massive $40 billion fraud risk driven by artificial intelligence. Firms such as Bain Capital, VanEck, and Pantera Capital are participating as design partners. The new offering aims to verify human identity and also allows users to delegate proofs to AI agents.
content_ta: AI-னால் ஏற்படும் 40 பில்லியன் டாலர் மோசடி அபாயத்தைக் சுட்டிக்காட்டி, Sam Altman-ன் World நிறுவனம் தனது proof-of-human அடையாள அமைப்பை வங்கிகளுக்கு விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. Bain Capital, VanEck மற்றும் Pantera Capital போன்ற நிறுவனங்கள் இதன் வடிவமைப்பு பங்காளிகளாக உள்ளன. மனித அடையாளத்தைச் சரிபார்ப்பதுடன், பயனர்கள் AI agents-களுக்கு proofs-ஐ வழங்கவும் இந்த புதிய offering அனுமதிக்கிறது.

title: World Launches World ID for Banking and Finance to Address AI-Driven Impersonation
summary:
At Money20/20, World co-founder Alex Blania unveiled World ID for banking and finance. Now available, the suite of technologies helps banks prevent deepfake fraud and AI-driven impersonation across customer accounts, employee workflows, and AI agents.
 
The suite of technologies brings together World ID app, World ID for Zoom, and World ID for Agents, giving banking and financial institutions greater assurance that transactions, trades, customer requests, and even important video communications are AI-safe.
 
World also announced the general availability of World ID for Zoom and that Tools for Humanity, a contributor to World, has joined Zoom’s independent software vendor (ISV) exchange program.
As AI-generated identities and impersonation techniques become more sophisticated, financial institutions face growing challenges in determining whether the individuals they interact with online are genuine. Deloitte predicts that AI-enabled fraud losses in the U.S. could reach $40 billion by 2027, up from an estimated $12.3 billion in 2023. These risks are particularly significant in banking, asset management, and other financial services, where digital interactions can involve sensitive information and consequential financial decisions.
 
World ID for banking and finance is designed to address these challenges by providing institutions with tools to establish human presence and verify relevant facts during digital interactions. The offering incorporates:
World ID app: an identity wallet that gives people a secure place to claim, manage, and present a set of AI-safe human Proofs needed to navigate the internet and digital services in the age of AI
World ID for Zoom: built for real-time communication, World ID for Zoom lets you confirm that the person you’re speaking with is human and not a deepfake
World ID for Agents: a person can establish Proofs about themselves and delegate them to an agent, allowing the agent to confirm those Proofs to a third-party platform
“As AI becomes increasingly prevalent in all aspects of our lives, enterprises are requesting individuals provide ‘Proofs’ about themselves to help mitigate fraud and increase trust,” said Sandro Herbig, president at Tools for Humanity, building technologies for World. “World ID for banking and finance offers a suite of tools to add an AI-safe trust layer across their internal and external systems.”
World is working with design partners including OpenExchange, Bain Capital, VanEck Funds, Pantera Capital, and Outtake to explore how its human infrastructure technology can support banking and financial services use cases. These collaborations demonstrate how World ID can be applied to the trust and verification challenges facing financial institutions.
 
The launch marks World's first industry-specific focus for World ID, with banking and finance selected because of the growing impact of AI-driven impersonation and the potential consequences of fraudulent interactions. By combining quantum-secure cryptographic Proof verification capabilities with tools for digital communication, World aims to help organizations establish greater confidence in the people and agents participating in sensitive interactions.

title: Case Study: How a Fintech Founder Launched an FCA-Licensed PSP Without Building Payment Infrastructure
summary:
From 2,000 to 4 million transactions a month. A fintech founder launched a payment service provider on Corefy’s white-label infrastructure, skipping at least two years of in-house development and going live two weeks after the demo.
The client
The company is an FCA-licensed payment service provider founded in 2021 by a fintech executive with more than 10 years in payments. It helps online businesses expand globally and sell locally. Merchants get local-currency payment options across regions, available through a single API integration and one dashboard.
The challenge: build or launch?
Before launch, the founder had to choose between building a payment platform from scratch and running the business on white-label infrastructure. Building in-house meant hiring a development and support team and spending years on technology before processing a single payment.
The market helped settle the decision. Several payment providers the founder planned to partner with asked whether the new PSP would integrate with Corefy, because that would make connecting with them faster. The founder then compared Corefy with another payment gateway. Corefy came out ahead on technical capabilities, tech support, and account management.
“Choosing between developing a PSP from scratch and opting for Corefy’s white-label solution, I chose the second, as it was faster and more cost-efficient.”
Founder & CEO
The solution
The PSP went from demo to first live transaction in two weeks. The setup covered:
Provider connectivity from day one. The client launched with ready-made provider integrations, so it could offer a wide range of currencies and alternative payment methods immediately. When the client needed a provider that wasn’t yet integrated, Corefy built it on request. About 20 such integrations had been delivered by the end of 2025.
Routing and cascading. The client worked with a dedicated account manager to configure routing rules for higher conversion.
Branded hosted payment page. The page carries the client’s own branding and is translated into dozens of languages, including Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, and Azerbaijani.
Operational control. One dashboard, analytics, and monthly reconciliation track income and costs per transaction and catch mismatches with provider statements.
Fraud prevention. A rule-based firewall checks each transaction against client-customised lists to reduce fraud and avoid scheme fines.
In practice: fixing a conversion leak
The account manager spotted unstable conversion in one currency on the live graphs. The cause turned out to be a single provider with recurring downtime. The team added a second provider as a failover and set cascading rules, so payments the first provider can’t process now go automatically to the second. Failed transactions dropped and conversion recovered.
Results
At least two years saved by not building an in-house development and support team
Two weeks from demo to first live transaction
About 20 new provider integrations delivered on request
Growth from about 2,000 to about 4 million transactions per month
Today the client’s team configures most of the platform independently and focuses on sales and business development, while Corefy handles infrastructure and maintenance.
“At the start of our cooperation with Corefy, the product seemed complicated. But using it now is a pleasure; I’ve learned a lot with our account manager’s help, and it’s now intuitive.”
